metrics.L1a_mapping: per atom and layout: k1 - k0 success CI lower > 0 and > 0.10 -> PART ADDS; else BACKBONE SUFFICES
metrics.L1b_mapping: per group and layout: P_min - servo CI lower > 0 and > 0.10 -> P_MIN BEATS SERVO; CI upper < 0 and < -0.10 -> SERVO BEATS P_MIN; else TIED
metrics.V1_mapping: familiar, pooled N1-N6: RECOVERS iff delta_p_A CI lower > 0 and > 0.10; STEERS iff delta_steer CI lower > 0 and > 0.10. yes/yes INSTRUCTION BINDING; no/yes HELD-OBJECT BINDING; no/no NOT THE INSTRUCTION; yes/no RECOVERS WITHOUT STEERING
metrics.labelled: post hoc; development reads; no training; changes no earlier verdict
metrics.prediction: V1 INSTRUCTION BINDING; L1a PART ADDS for both atoms in the familiar layout; L1b SERVO BEATS P_MIN in the new layout, TIED in the familiar
metrics.states: dev only: N2 main states 4-23, N2 seeds; no confirmatory or sealed read; demos never executed
metrics.written_before: any V1 or L1 run or read
